g.text: FROM PAGE TO SCREEN / 04 · PPMI IN EACH MEDIUM

text.style: font-size: 27px; font-family: 'DejaVu Serif'; text-anchor: start; fill: #243e3b
font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #66796f

g.text: The same nearby-word vocabulary, with separate book and film association scores across the series.

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #66796f

g.text: Longer bars mean stronger-than-expected association. n is the number of nearby word pairs, not independent scenes.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #66796f

g.text: Contexts rank by pooled PPMI among pairs seen ≥3 times overall; only alphabetic non-stopwords are displayed. Pale bars have fewer than 3 pairs in that medium.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #66796f

g.text: Window: ±5 original token positions within one dialogue line. PPMI is an association weight; these differences are descriptive, not significance tests.
